title: Run Argus-driven visual and behavioral overhaul pass for Atelier tools
operator_request: After native/state work, visually and behaviorally overhaul CKC/Posekit inside Handshake so it mirrors the original app more, with Argus checking panels, tabs, overview, navigation, layout, and style.

state_recovery.recovery_rule: Only start after main surfaces exist. Use Argus headlessly; do not pop the app foreground for visual inspection.

scope.summary: Polish the live Atelier product experience against original CKC/Posekit workflow intent, using Argus as the proof path.
base_scope: Inspect every Atelier tab and major state through Argus snapshots/screenshots.
Fix clutter, overlapping text, confusing labels, dead controls, and incoherent navigation.
Check CKC book layout, Posekit split view, Ingest review flow, and manual discoverability.
Record remaining visual/behavioral gaps as follow-up MTs instead of claiming parity.
Update internal UserManual if navigation or behavior changes.
acceptance_criteria: Argus can see and steer all core Atelier workflows.
Layouts are readable and do not overlap at tested desktop/constrained sizes.
Residual gaps are explicit and not represented as complete.
verification: Focused UI tests for navigation and layout states.
Adversarial visual review before and after fixes.

manual_requirement: Required for any changed behavior or navigation.

handoff.note: MT-023 is ready for validator review. This is not official validation; validator_verdict remains PENDING.

validation_evidence.proof_summary: MT-023 Argus-driven visual/behavioral pass corrected Atelier navigation labels to match authority (module-ckc visible Atelier, inner CKC tab label CKC, module-ingest distinct/deep-linked), collapsed Settings/Model Ops by default while keeping Argus-openable controls, improved CKC sub-700 Story layout, Posekit framing/source preview readability, Ingest metadata/readout clipping, updated manual guidance, and recorded ARGUS-012/HBR-VIS-002 evidence.

validation_v1.validated_by: INTEGRATION_VALIDATOR (acting as per-MT WP Validator per Operator directive)
validation_v1.method: Committed-source review (git base 6bb8cfb4..HEAD) + WP_VALIDATOR mechanical gates (boundary/hygiene/scope) + Spec-Realism Gate SR1/SR2/SR3, across 14 read-only sub-agents that each read Codex v1.4 + WP_VALIDATOR_PROTOCOL. Fresh runtime re-execution was ENVIRONMENT_BLOCKED_HOST_OOM at validation time (backend later recompiled clean after Operator freed memory).
validation_v1.basis: Entire Argus visual/behavioral overhaul uncommitted; residual Posekit overflow unresolved.
validation_v1.fail_report: No commit in 6bb8cfb4..HEAD references MT-023; all owned frontend edits (atelier_panel.rs, module_switcher.rs, pane_header.rs, tests) are uncommitted with large -w diffs, and the visual PNG proof lives outside git under ../Handshake_Artifacts/. The contract itself records an unresolved Posekit-preview-below-viewport overflow that fails a readability AC.
validation_v1.remediation_plan: 1) git add -p to isolate the MT-023 frontend layout/label/manual hunks from tangled MT-022/024 and inherited dirt; skip test_pane_header.rs unrelated topology failures. 2) Resolve OR explicitly defer (with a tracked follow-up) the Posekit-preview overflow at sub-760x640. 3) Commit 'feat: MT-023 Argus visual/behavioral overhaul', regenerate the proof PNGs into ../Handshake_Artifacts/, re-run targeted tests, and re-submit.
